FileLog: Construct a new `FileLog` that writes to the file at `path`.
append: Writes a single log line: the padded `label`, an ISO-8601 timestamp, and the formatted `data`, terminated by a newline.
close: Closes the underlying file descriptor and stops the rotation timer. Safe to call more than once.
FileLogOptions.maxSize: The size, in bytes, at which the log file is rotated. Default `0`, which disables rotation.
FileLogOptions.rotate: Given the current log path, returns the path to archive it to before it is rotated. Default `null`, in which case the log is truncated in place. If it throws, rotation falls back to truncation.
FileLogOptions.rotateInterval: How often, in milliseconds, the log size is checked against `maxSize`. Default `2000`.
FileLogEvents.rotate: Emitted after the log file is rotated, with the log `path` and the archive path, or `null` when the log was truncated in place.
